_about: Limits for bench/perf_check.py on the GitHub-hosted runners, checked against the median of 3 runs. 'measured' is the runner's typical median when the limits were set (17 Nov 2026, main at 215a50e, macos-latest, 3 runs, ad-block lists compiled). Headroom: memory +35-40% over the highest run median (medians 106-111 MB, collapsed 149-159; the Nov 2026 interface regression was +80 MB); idle CPU a couple of points (it reads 0.1-0.4%, the hidden progress-bar bug read 12%); launch is noisy on shared runners, so its limit only catches a gross stall; binary size +5%, so growth is a decision.
